# Élan Clinic — elanclinic.ee

## About
Élan Clinic is a physician-led weight management clinic in Tallinn, Estonia (licensed medical practice). We specialise in long-term weight maintenance and weight regain prevention, including for patients who have used GLP‑1 medications.

## What we do (high level)
- Physician-led initial consultation
- Metabolic health assessment and monitoring (labs and body composition where appropriate)
- Personalised nutrition and resistance-training protocol (maintenance-focused)
- Structured follow-up and behavioural support
